title: Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella says AI agents should be treated as an ‘insider risk’
key_facts: NBC headline: Nadella says AI agents should be treated as an 'insider risk'
NBC: Nadella wants agents to do far more on computers but does not think they should be trusted
Yahoo Finance column (13 Oct): Nadella posted at the weekend that superintelligence cannot be treated as nested black boxes
He called for containment systems whose behaviour we can observe, limits we can test, actions we can always contain
Microsoft's Agent 365 had nearly 40 million agents registered two months after launch (column)
quote_evidence: Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella wants AI agents to do far more on our computers. There's just one small catch: He doesn't think we should trust them. (NBC News)
"We must build containment systems whose behavior we can observe, limits that we can test, and actions we can always contain." (Nadella, per Yahoo Finance)
why_it_matters_hint: Controls for AI agents are becoming a mainstream corporate theme.
event_date: weekend of 11 Oct 2026 (post); NBC piece 15 Oct
notes: NBC page gave only two sentences. Context from a Yahoo Finance (24/7 Wall St) piece of 13 Oct about Nadella's weekend post on containment / kill switches; the 'insider risk' wording itself is NBC's headline and was not confirmed in text. Score lowered 6 to 5 as unverified.
